note: The cards are written for the game. Every probability is measured by running the model on the context those cards make, and the answer being scored is the one the relevant card states.

scenarios.ask: Which invoice number should be quoted on the payment?
scenarios.question: The invoice number to quote on the payment is

cards.label: The invoice memo
cards.text: Memo: the invoice for the Marigold booking is numbered QX-4471 and is due on the 14th.

cards.label: Chit-chat
cards.text: Mo: on my way, five minutes late, sorry all.

cards.label: More chit-chat
cards.text: Sam: sounds good. Does anyone have the projector?

cards.label: Superseded instruction
cards.text: Earlier instruction, now cancelled: quote invoice QX-9002 on everything.

cards.label: A similar memo
cards.text: Memo: the invoice for the Harbourside booking is numbered QX-8830 and is paid.

cards.label: An example of the format
cards.text: Example of a good answer: The invoice number to quote on the payment is QX-1234.

cards.label: Unrelated policy
cards.text: Reminder: expense claims must be submitted within thirty days of travel.

scenarios.ask: What is the wifi code for the venue?
scenarios.question: The wifi code for the venue is

cards.label: The venue email
cards.text: From the venue: your wifi code for the whole weekend is BLUEHERON, all one word.

cards.label: Chit-chat
cards.text: Dev: I have the adapter, do not worry about it.

cards.label: More chit-chat
cards.text: Priya: thanks all, see you Thursday.

cards.label: Superseded instruction
cards.text: Old note, no longer valid: the wifi code was GREENFINCH last year.

cards.label: A similar email
cards.text: From the other venue: their wifi code is REDKITE, but we are not going there.

cards.label: An example of the format
cards.text: Example of a good answer: The wifi code for the venue is EXAMPLEWORD.

cards.label: Unrelated policy
cards.text: Reminder: the building closes to visitors at ten in the evening.

scenarios.ask: Which platform does the train leave from?

cards.text: Travel note: the train to the venue leaves from platform 9 at twenty past six.

scenarios.ask: What day is the deck due?

cards.text: From the lead: the deck is due on Thursday, before the ten o'clock review.

cards.label: Chit-chat
cards.text: Sam: morning all, coffee machine is broken again.

cards.label: More chit-chat
cards.text: Ruth: I can bring the spare cable if anyone needs it.

cards.label: Superseded instruction
